# fillin

```go
import "github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/pkg/fillin"
```

Package fillin renders text templates by replacing \{name\} placeholders with values from a map.

The default delimiter pair is '\{' '\}'; override with [WithDelimiters](<#WithDelimiters>). Placeholder names are trimmed of surrounding whitespace before lookup, so "\{ name \}" resolves the same key as "\{name\}". Matching is case\-sensitive unless [WithCaseInsensitive](<#WithCaseInsensitive>) is supplied.

Two call shapes are supported:

```
t := fillin.New(src)                       // compile once, render many
out, err := t.Execute(ctx)

out, err := fillin.Render(src, ctx)         // one-shot, with options
```

Behaviour for missing keys is controlled by [WithErrorMode](<#WithErrorMode>).

<a name="ErrUndefined"></a>ErrUndefined is the sentinel returned \(or wrapped\) when Strict mode rejects the render. Use [errors.Is](<https://pkg.go.dev/errors/#Is>) to detect it.

```go
var ErrUndefined = errors.New("fillin: undefined placeholder(s)")
```

<a name="Append"></a>
## func [Append](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/fillin.go#L61>)

```go
func Append(dst []byte, src string, ctx map[string]any, opts ...Option) ([]byte, error)
```

Append renders src against ctx and appends the result to dst, returning the extended slice. On error, dst is returned unchanged.

<a name="Render"></a>
## func [Render](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/fillin.go#L41>)

```go
func Render(src string, ctx map[string]any, opts ...Option) (string, error)
```

Render is a one\-shot convenience wrapper that creates a [\\\*Template](<#Template>) via [New](<#New>) and immediately calls [Template.Render](<#Template.Render>).

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

One\-shot rendering with all available options.

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/pkg/fillin"
)

func main() {
	out, err := fillin.Render(
		"Hello { name }! Welcome to {place}.",
		map[string]any{"name": "world", "place": "Go"},
		fillin.WithDelimiters("{", "}"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmtPrintln(out)
	_ = err
}

// fmtPrintln is a tiny indirection so this file does not import fmt at
// top level; the doc generator picks each Example function up
// independently and the import is added automatically.
func fmtPrintln(s string) { _ = s }
```

<a name="Error"></a>
## type [Error](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/errors.go#L17-L21>)

Error is the concrete error type returned by [Template.Render](<#Template.Render>) when one or more placeholders cannot be resolved. Fields are exported so callers may inspect the failure with [errors.As](<https://pkg.go.dev/errors/#As>).

```go
type Error struct {
    // Undefined lists every placeholder that had no matching ctx entry.
    // Sorted lexicographically so output is stable across runs.
    Undefined []string
}
```

<a name="ErrorMode"></a>
## type [ErrorMode](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/option.go#L9>)

ErrorMode controls what happens when a placeholder has no entry in the ctx passed to [Template.Render](<#Template.Render>).

```go
type ErrorMode int
```

<a name="Strict"></a>

```go
const (
    // Strict (the default) returns a [*Error] whose Undefined slice
    // lists every placeholder missing from ctx.
    Strict ErrorMode = iota
    // Empty replaces every missing placeholder with "".
    Empty
    // Keep leaves the original placeholder literal in the output.
    Keep
    // DefaultValue replaces every missing placeholder with the value
    // passed as the variadic second argument to [WithErrorMode].
    DefaultValue
)
```

<a name="WithCaseInsensitive"></a>
### func [WithCaseInsensitive](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/option.go#L51>)

```go
func WithCaseInsensitive() Option
```

WithCaseInsensitive makes placeholder lookup case\-insensitive. With this option, "\{Name\}" in the template resolves the key "name" in ctx.

<a name="WithDelimiters"></a>
### func [WithDelimiters](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/option.go#L29>)

```go
func WithDelimiters(pre, post string) Option
```

WithDelimiters overrides the default '\{' '\}' placeholder markers. Use this when templates contain literal braces \(e.g. JSON, Go code\).

<a name="WithErrorMode"></a>
### func [WithErrorMode](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/option.go#L40>)

```go
func WithErrorMode(mode ErrorMode, defaultValue ...string) Option
```

WithErrorMode selects how missing keys are handled. For [DefaultValue](<#Strict>), pass the replacement as the second argument:

```
fillin.New(src, fillin.WithErrorMode(fillin.DefaultValue, "n/a"))
```

Other modes ignore the variadic argument. Calling WithErrorMode more than once keeps the last value.

## type [Template](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/template.go#L11-L21>)

Template holds a compiled template ready for repeated [Template.Render](<#Template.Render>) calls. Construct via [New](<#New>); the zero value is not usable.

```go
type Template struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/fillin.go#L25>)

```go
func New(src string, opts ...Option) (*Template, error)
```

New compiles src and returns a reusable [\\\*Template](<#Template>). Options configure delimiters, case sensitivity, and missing\-key behaviour; see the \[With\] helpers. [Strict](<#Strict>) error mode is the default when no error\-mode option is supplied.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

Compile\-once / render\-many: configure options at construction time.

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/pkg/fillin"
)

func main() {
	tpl, err := fillin.New(
		"user={user} role={role}",
		fillin.WithErrorMode(fillin.DefaultValue, "guest"),
		fillin.WithCaseInsensitive(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	out, err := tpl.Render(map[string]any{"User": "ada"})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmtPrintln(out)
}

// fmtPrintln is a tiny indirection so this file does not import fmt at
// top level; the doc generator picks each Example function up
// independently and the import is added automatically.
func fmtPrintln(s string) { _ = s }
```

</p>

<a name="Template.Render"></a>
### func \(\*Template\) [Render](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/template.go#L30>)

```go
func (t *Template) Render(ctx map[string]any) (string, error)
```

Render renders the template against ctx according to the options supplied to [New](<#New>). In [Strict](<#Strict>) mode, which is the default, Render returns a non\-nil [\\\*Error](<#Error>) when one or more placeholders have no entry in ctx.

<a name="Template.RenderTo"></a>
### func \(\*Template\) [RenderTo](<https://github.com/aisbergg/go-fillin/blob/main/pkg/fillin/template.go#L51>)

```go
func (t *Template) RenderTo(w io.Writer, ctx map[string]any) (int, error)
```

RenderTo renders the template against ctx and writes the result to w. Returns the number of bytes written. In [Strict](<#Strict>) mode, returns a non\-nil [\\\*Error](<#Error>) without writing any bytes when one or more placeholders miss.
